text: This solution, Developing Climate Disaster Financing Framework and Parametric Insurance in Fiji (CDRFF and Parametric Micro‑Insurance) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Republic of Fiji between Government of Fiji, Reserve Bank of Fiji (RBF), UNCDF/PICAP, UNDP, UNU‑EHS, India‑UN Partnership Fund, UNOSSC, InsuResilience Solutions Fund, Commonwealth Secretariat, SUN Insurance, FijiCare Insurance, and Tower Insurance. The program was implemented in 2020 and focuses on collaboration, accessibility, and leveraging tech.
